banks.name: TIGER v106
banks.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 plus Commons Clause; noncommercial use, credit and character rules
banks.reason: Official releases remove Chinese voice mode in v102, add Mandarin dictionary in v103 but do not establish full Mandarin support or naturalness in v106. No local compatible package tested.

banks.name: Lewy / Lewisia
banks.reason: Officially described as a soft young female voice, not the requested male bank. Terms restrict synthesis engines to UTAU/OpenUtau/UTAU-Synth and prohibit AI training on output. Do not substitute generic Python inference or clone outputs.

banks.name: Denji DS
banks.reason: Mandarin support advertised. Terms require permission for derivatives and retention of character age/personality. No explicit clearance found for using voice as these distinct story characters; not treated as blanket free permission.

banks.name: ACV-001
banks.reason: Explicit credited native Mandarin male singing dataset, but reviewed official repository does not provide a ready tested acoustic/variance/vocoder package. No training run authorized or started.

decision: No verified ready pair in bounded screening. Stop singer renders; do not imply all open-source banks are unavailable.
